notes.title: Eden Survivors: Now in Early Access! Play, Explore, and Share Your Feedback
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176828/c12f4e5dc2a575d4f32c6510f5cb1f338ac07f11.jpg[/img]
[h2]Eden Survivors is now available in Early Access![/h2]
The wait is over! 🌟 We’re thrilled to announce that Eden Survivors is now available on Early Access on Steam. This is just the beginning of an adventure we’ll build together, and we want YOU to be a part of it!

🎮 What’s included in this Early Access version?

This first version is packed with content ready for you to explore:

[list]
[*] 1 complete biome, full of secrets to uncover and challenges to conquer.
[*] All abilities and a progression tree, giving you the freedom to experiment and adapt your playstyle.
[*] 4 unique mechs, each with its own gameplay style for you to master.
[*] All final bosses of the first biome, bringing epic challenges we can’t wait for you to tackle!
[*] 20 to 100 hours of gameplay, depending on how deeply you dive into this epic experience.
[/list]
🗨️ Your feedback is key
This is just the beginning. We want to hear your thoughts and learn how we can improve. Share your feedback on our forums, social media, or Discord. Your input will be essential to shaping Eden Survivors into its best version!

📣 Join the conversation: Forums, Discord, Social Media, 

🚀 Play, explore, and be part of Eden Survivors’ evolution

[h3]Thank you for joining us on this journey. See you on the battlefield![/h3]
